definition: Instinct is an AI agent from Spear Street that handles travel bookings and everyday errands over SMS and WhatsApp. You text what you need, and it does the legwork.
extendedDescription:
Instinct works where you already text. There is no app to learn and no dashboard to check. You send a message about a flight, a booking, or an errand, and the agent works through it for you.

The product has grown through a waitlist, focused on nailing travel and errands before expanding further. That narrow focus is the point: Instinct wants to be the fastest way to hand off a task by text.

SMS agents trade depth for convenience. They are great at single tasks with a clear outcome, like booking a trip. They do not read your inbox, manage your calendar, or remember how you work across weeks and months.

howGaiaUsesIt: GAIA meets you in the same places: it works in WhatsApp and Telegram, not just on the web. The difference is scope. GAIA also reads your email, manages your calendar, and remembers context across all of it, so a trip it books connects to your schedule, your inbox, and your tasks without you repeating yourself.
